title: Foraging Patch Revisit Cooldown
dataSources: Fishing catches (`fishing:catch`), fishfinder sonar (`fishfinder:reading`), foraging finds (`foraging:find`), game-cam triggers (`gamecam:trigger`).
app: Outdoor logs — fishing apps (Fishbrain), sonar / fishfinder exports, game/trail cameras, and foraging journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=foraging:find patch_id=*
| stats latest(_time) as last_visit, count as visits by patch_id species
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_visit)/86400,0)
| sort days_since
description: Tracks how long it has been since each patch was last revisited.
value: A revisit cooldown helps avoid over-harvesting the same spot just because it is familiar and easy.
implementation: Log foraging finds with patch identifiers; review days since last visit by patch and species.
visualization: Patch table of visit count and days since last revisit.
grandmaExplanation: It compares how long each foraging patch has been left to recover before you go back again.
